description: Cancels one session on the agenda of an event the person organizes: the session is marked cancelled on the agenda and kept on record rather than deleted. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm`: the reply is a PREVIEW with a `changeId`, the before and after of each field, how many pass holders would be notified and the exact notice, and nothing changes. Read that preview back to the organizer; only when they say yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. A cancellation is quiet unless `notify` is true, which notifies pass holders. Name the session by the `sessionId` the agenda gave or by its title; if the reply says AMBIGUOUS or NO_SUCH_SESSION, read the candidates back and ask which one. Only the organizer of the event can change it; anybody else is refused, and the refusal is read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

at.description: OPTIONAL. The session's current start ("10:30 AM"), which distinguishes sessions that share a title.

changeId.description: REQUIRED with confirm: the changeId the preview returned.

confirm.description: Leave out for the PREVIEW. Only after the organizer says yes to the preview, call again with confirm: true and the changeId.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.

notify.description: OPTIONAL. Quiet by default; true notifies pass holders of the change.

sessionId.description: The session's id exactly as the agenda or a candidates list gave it.

sessionTitle.description: Or the session's title as the agenda spells it, when there is no sessionId.

name: event_session_cancel
title: Cancel a session (organizers only)
